Rosa Alvarez

Founder and CEO of Harbor Lights Coffee. Portland, Oregon. I started roasting in a garage in 2014 and now run three roasteries (Portland, Austin, Denver) with a team of about seventy. I write here about coffee sourcing, running a small company, and leading people who are better at their jobs than I am.

Experience

  • Founder and CEO, Harbor Lights Coffee (2014 – present)
  • Head roaster, Burnside Roasting Collective (2011 – 2014)
  • Barista and trainer, Stumptown-adjacent café nobody remembers (2008 – 2011)

Skills

Green coffee sourcing, roast profiling, cupping, direct-trade negotiation, hiring, public speaking, regional expansion.
